headline: Brazil Approves Antidumping Duties on Steel Imports from China and Europe
summary: Brazil's foreign trade chamber approved definitive antidumping duties on hot-rolled flat steel from China and tinplate from Germany, the Netherlands, and Japan following requests by local producers.
why: Antidumping tariffs protect domestic manufacturing industries from foreign import competition, directly impacting pricing power and revenues for domestic steelmakers like Usiminas and Gerdau.

impacts.name: Usiminas
impacts.why: Tariffs on foreign steel imports reduce pricing pressure from international competitors for domestic producers.
